Name: Pierre Cola
Author: Meurer13
Description:
Pierre jealous of Morris created his own soda but something didn't go as expected.

Pierre Cola came to compete with Joja Cola and become the new trend in Pelican Town.


#### What's in mod? ####

New dialogues for NPCs when they receive Pierre Cola as a gift

Pierre Cola is sold at Pierre's General Store

Pierre Cola has a small chance of being fished

For Custom NPCs, Pierre Cola is hated

Compatible with the Friendship Affects Prices mod

This mod does not replace any in-game items.
